author: Seung Wook
problem: Takahashi moves from floor X to a different floor Y of a 100-floor building. He uses the stairs if he goes up by at most two floors or down by at most three floors, and the elevator otherwise; print Yes if he uses the stairs, otherwise No.
bug_description: The upward case uses k>=2 instead of k<=2, so going up 1 floor gives No and going up 3 or more gives Yes.

comments.accurate: Prints Yes when the move is up at most two floors or down at most three, meaning the stairs are used
comments.wrong_behavior: Stairs are used for going down at most three floors, or for going up two floors or more
comments.wrong_location: Upward case verified; check the downward limit of three floors in the X > Y branch
